chapterGuidance: The chapter column accepts a chapter name (for example, Functions) or a parent > child path (for example, Chapter 1 > Functions). The system searches by name within the topic and creates missing chapters when you confirm the import. Include the full path if a name is ambiguous.
importFilesMustNotExceed20: Import files must not exceed 20 MB
unableToLoadAndProcessImport: Unable to load and process import file
importedAndAttachedQuestionsToThe: Imported and attached questions to the test
useAFixedTemplateCheckFor: Use the provided template, review the rows, then create the questions.
usedForLinesThatLeaveThe: Used for lines that leave the chapter column blank.
retryCompleteHint: The file has been uploaded. Retry confirmation to start processing.
unableToLoadTopics: Unable to load topics. Please try again.
createTopicFirst: Create at least one topic in the question bank before importing a file.
wordTemplateNewTab: Word template (opens in a new tab)
excelTemplateNewTab: Excel template (opens in a new tab)
templatePreviewDescription: Review the structure, instructions and sample questions before preparing your import file.
wordStructureHint: Put each question in a separate table. Keep the field names in the left column exactly as provided in the Word template.
excelStructureHint: Enter data in the Questions sheet, one question per row. Keep the column names in the first row unchanged; the Instructions sheet contains guidance.
replaceExamplesHint: Download the template if needed, then edit or delete the three sample questions before uploading the file.
embeddedImagesHint: Paste images directly into the image cell for the relevant question. Do not use local file paths. The import file must be .docx or .xlsx and no larger than 20 MB.
reviewBeforeImportHint: Select a topic and default chapter on the import page, upload the file, review or edit each row, then select valid questions to confirm the import into the bank.
previewOnlyHint: This is a reference preview, not a file editor. Embedded images are represented by labels; the downloadable template retains the original images.
fieldCode: A unique row code within the file, for example Q001.
fieldChapter: A chapter name or Parent chapter > Child chapter path within the selected topic. Missing chapters are created when the import is confirmed; leave blank to use the default chapter.
fieldType: SINGLE_CHOICE (one answer), MULTIPLE_CHOICE (multiple answers) or ESSAY.
fieldText: Question content. LaTeX formulas using the system syntax are supported.
fieldImage: Paste images directly into the image cell. Multiple images are supported; leave blank if not needed.
fieldOptions: The text for options A through F. Leave unused options blank, and leave all option cells blank for essay questions.
fieldCorrectKeys: One answer: A. Multiple answers: A,C. Leave blank for essay questions.
fieldEssayAnswer: The model answer for an essay question. Leave blank for choice questions.
sampleGraphQuestion: Which function is represented by the graph?
sampleEmbeddedImage: [Graph image embedded in the template file]
samplePrimeQuestion: Which of the following numbers are prime?
